say:1:1820624001:0.text: Twilight Village's in danger. Someone has to protect Baba Muriel.
say:1:1820624001:0.source_cn: 夕染村有危险，需要有人去保护穆婆婆。因此我赶回来，特意...

say:2:1820624002:0.text: Who's willing to come with me?

say:6:1820624003:0.source_cn: 哼，哼哧~这里没有人，我们是动物。

say:7:1820624004:0.text: Your mind's getting fuzzy. We used to be human! Baba Muriel helped us!
say:7:1820624004:0.source_cn: 你的头脑越来越不好使了。俺们以前是人。穆婆婆是俺们的恩人。

say:9:1820624006:0.text: Still, I can't fight. Just count me out.
say:9:1820624006:0.source_cn: 我还想起来，我不会打架。那我不去了。

say:10:1820624007:0.source_cn: 呼哧、呼哧！没药可救的家伙！

say:11:1820624008:0.text: Jay, what happened to the village? Isn't Hilda standing guard there?
say:11:1820624008:0.source_cn: 杰农，夕染村出了什么事？希尔达就守卫在村外，不够吗？

choice_prompt:12:1820624008.text: Jay, what happened to the village? Isn't Hilda standing guard there?
choice_prompt:12:1820624008.source_cn: 杰农，夕染村出了什么事？希尔达就守卫在村外，不够吗？

say:13:1820624009:0.text: Look, we've got some new faces here.

say:14:1820624010:0.text: New faces, the first thing you should do is find a big tree and carve your names into it, so you won't forget them.
say:14:1820624010:0.source_cn: 新同伴，你们得找一棵显眼的树刻上名字，免得忘记。

say:18:1820624012:0.text: Jay bears down on you and Thane, sniffing both of you thoroughly.
say:18:1820624012:0.source_cn: 杰农气势汹汹地靠近了你和瑟恩，使劲嗅闻着你们身上的气味。
say:18:1820624012:0.male: Jay bears down on you and Thane, sniffing both of you thoroughly.
say:18:1820624012:0.female: Jay bears down on you and Thane, sniffing both of you thoroughly.

say:19:1820624013:0.text: It's you! Baba Muriel brought you back to the village!
say:19:1820624013:0.source_cn: 是你们，被穆婆婆带回村里的那两个人！
say:19:1820624013:0.male: It's you! Baba Muriel brought you back to the village!
say:19:1820624013:0.female: It's you! Baba Muriel brought you back to the village!

say:20:1820624014:0.text: Baba Muriel didn't use magic on you two! How did you end up as animals, and why did you come to us?
say:20:1820624014:0.source_cn: 你们为什么来到这里？为什么会变成动物？这不是穆婆婆的魔法！
say:20:1820624014:0.male: Baba Muriel didn't use magic on you two! How did you end up as animals, and why did you come to us?
say:20:1820624014:0.female: Baba Muriel didn't use magic on you two! How did you end up as animals, and why did you come to us?

choice_prompt:21:1820624014.text: Baba Muriel didn't use magic on you two! How did you end up as animals, and why did you come to us?
choice_prompt:21:1820624014.source_cn: 你们为什么来到这里？为什么会变成动物？这不是穆婆婆的魔法！
choice_prompt:21:1820624014.male: Baba Muriel didn't use magic on you two! How did you end up as animals, and why did you come to us?
choice_prompt:21:1820624014.female: Baba Muriel didn't use magic on you two! How did you end up as animals, and why did you come to us?

say:22:1820624015:0.text: Liar! I can tell you're lying!
say:22:1820624015:0.source_cn: 你撒谎！我闻到了谎言的味道！
say:22:1820624015:0.male: Liar! I can tell you're lying!
say:22:1820624015:0.female: Liar! I can tell you're lying!

say:24:1820624018:0.text: Since they came from the village, they should know what happened there.
say:24:1820624018:0.source_cn: 他们从夕染村来，该问问他们出了什么事。

say:25:1820624019:0.text: Baba Muriel mentioned Bantus... That's not a good sign.
say:25:1820624019:0.source_cn: 穆婆婆提到了班题斯，那就不会是好事。

say:27:1820624020:0.text: Let's get the full story from the new faces.
say:27:1820624020:0.source_cn: 看来穆婆婆说的话，你没有完全听懂。是该听听新同伴的发言。

say:30:1820624021:0.text: ... In short, Bantus is after Baba Muriel.
say:30:1820624021:0.source_cn: ……简单地说，班题斯要抓捕穆婆婆。

say:31:1820624022:0.text: That's it? Can you be more specific? We need more details!
say:31:1820624022:0.source_cn: 这也太简单了。有没有详细一点的？原因，过程，结果。

say:34:1820624023:0.text: Enough! This discussion is going nowhere! Bantus is after Baba Muriel, and she told us to go into hiding! That's all we need to know!
say:34:1820624023:0.source_cn: 够了！不要再浪费口舌！班题斯的追捕，穆婆婆让我们躲起来...

say:35:1820624024:0.text: If you want to protect Twilight Village, come with me. If not, stay behind. Simple as that.
say:35:1820624024:0.source_cn: 想保护夕染村的，跟我回去。不愿走的，留下。就这么简单！

choice_prompt:36:1820624024.text: If you want to protect Twilight Village, come with me. If not, stay behind. Simple as that.
choice_prompt:36:1820624024.source_cn: 想保护夕染村的，跟我回去。不愿走的，留下。就这么简单！

say:37:1820624025:0.text: Shut up! Nobody asked for your opinion!
say:37:1820624025:0.source_cn: 闭嘴！这里轮不到你说话！
say:37:1820624025:0.male: Shut up! Nobody asked for your opinion!
say:37:1820624025:0.female: Shut up! Nobody asked for your opinion!

say:38:1820624026:0.text: Stay where you are. If you go back now, you'll only make things worse for Baba Muriel.
say:38:1820624026:0.source_cn: ——站住。你们现在回去，只会给她徒增麻烦。

say:39:1820624027:0.text: The best thing you can do for her now is leave the village and stay safe.
say:39:1820624027:0.source_cn: 别浪费她的一片好心，赶紧离开夕染村。

say:40:1820624028:0.text: Nonsense! It'd be selfish of us to leave Baba in the lurch!
say:40:1820624028:0.source_cn: 现在是危机关头！没有时间瞻前顾后，听你胡说！

say:43:1820624030:0.text: They're really digging their heels in... Looks like they've started thinking like animals!
say:43:1820624030:0.source_cn: 这群固执的亡灵……他们的思维全都被动物的身躯限制住了！

say:44:1820624031:0.text: Let's <style="highlight">head back to Twilight Village</style> at once and tell Baba Muriel about this!

choice:36:1:2.text: Didn't Baba Muriel tell you to stay away from the village?!
choice:36:1:2.source_cn: 你不是应该听穆婆婆的话吗？！
choice:36:1:2.male: Didn't Baba Muriel tell you to stay away from the village?!
choice:36:1:2.female: Didn't Baba Muriel tell you to stay away from the village?!

choice:21:0:1.text: Just to make sure Pipp gets back safely.
choice:21:0:1.male: Just to make sure Pipp gets back safely.
choice:21:0:1.female: Just to make sure Pipp gets back safely.

say:46:1820624016:0.text: Now that you've got your answer, leave!
say:46:1820624016:0.source_cn: 那你们现在知道了。离开这里！
say:46:1820624016:0.male: Now that you've got your answer, leave!
say:46:1820624016:0.female: Now that you've got your answer, leave!

choice:21:1:2.text: I was just wondering how you became animals.
choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 只是好奇你们为什么会变成动物
choice:21:1:2.male: I was just wondering how you became animals.
choice:21:1:2.female: I was just wondering how you became animals.

say:47:1820624017:0.text: But your mana is weaker than Baba Muriel's.
say:47:1820624017:0.source_cn: 但你的魔力不如穆婆婆。
say:47:1820624017:0.male: But your mana is weaker than Baba Muriel's.
say:47:1820624017:0.female: But your mana is weaker than Baba Muriel's.

choice_prompt:48:1820624017.text: But your mana is weaker than Baba Muriel's.
choice_prompt:48:1820624017.source_cn: 但你的魔力不如穆婆婆。
choice_prompt:48:1820624017.male: But your mana is weaker than Baba Muriel's.
choice_prompt:48:1820624017.female: But your mana is weaker than Baba Muriel's.

choice:48:0:1.text: ... That's only because I don't know gravecalling magic!
choice:48:0:1.male: ... That's only because I don't know gravecalling magic!
choice:48:0:1.female: ... That's only because I don't know gravecalling magic!

choice:21:2:3.text: I cast a spell and turned myself into an animal.
choice:21:2:3.source_cn: 能变成动物是多亏了我的魔法
choice:21:2:3.male: I cast a spell and turned myself into an animal.
choice:21:2:3.female: I cast a spell and turned myself into an animal.

choice:12:1:2.text: That treant Baba Muriel mentioned before?
choice:12:1:2.male: That treant Baba Muriel mentioned before?
choice:12:1:2.female: That treant Baba Muriel mentioned before?
